name: Peugeot 103
engine: 49 cc air-cooled two-stroke single, premix, variator on some
intro: Peugeot's long-running moped. Simple two-stroke, premix and a lot of tuning parts in Europe.

B: Moped two-strokes run premix. Mix the oil into the fuel at the ratio in the manual, usually around 50 to 1 with modern oil.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
